# Cross-pair condition: stem_i 5' half pairs with stem_j 3' half if 5'_i == revcomp(3'_j) == revcomp(revcomp(5'_j)) == 5'_j... 
# Actually 3' = revcomp(5') for any valid stem, so cross-pair happens iff 5'_i == 5'_j (same 5' half). 
# So just make all 16 stems (4 blocks x 3 hp x ... ) have DISTINCT 5' halves AND distinct from outer 5' halves!

# But wait, that's only true for stem-vs-stem of SAME LENGTH. Outer is 3bp, hairpins 4bp -> different length, 
# but 3 of outer's 4... no, outer 5' is 3 chars, can't perfectly pair 4-char hairpin. But partial pairing possible.
# Simplify: make every 5' half (across all stems, both 3bp outer and 4bp hairpin) unique, GC-rich.
# For 4bp hairpin stems, choose 5' halves of length 4.
